front.title: Signer-Zone Containment for DNSSEC Wildcard Validation

author.organization: The University of Texas at Dallas

abstract.t: Validators for the DNS Security Extensions (DNSSEC) reconstruct the original owner name of a signed resource record set (RRset) using the RRSIG Labels field. If the reconstructed owner is outside the signing zone, a cryptographically correct signature can be misinterpreted as authenticating wildcard data belonging to another zone. Aggressive use of DNSSEC-validated caches can extend the effect to other names. This document updates RFC 4035 to require signer-zone containment of the reconstructed owner and updates RFC 8198 to preserve that authenticated relationship when reusing wildcard data. These requirements introduce no changes to DNS message formats.
